walls.note: The Prins Hendrikkade front, east bay (facade ring edge 1, 4.87 m): the entrance to the passage. Read on the rectified 2025 crop (w04-42.jpg, 50 px/m, heights from its foot) and the 2025 aimed view, which shows the whole three-bay front: this bay, the central balcony bay between two projecting stone piers (ring edges 2-8: 0.95 m piers standing 0.64 m proud and a 3.45 m bay) and the west bay (w05). Upper storeys of the two side bays are alike; the central-bay items are listed here because that bay (3.45 m) is below the brief's 4 m cut.
